issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]は体[からだ]が{冷[ひ]えます|tr-okiru}ので、上着[うわぎ]を持[も]っていってください。
issues.problem: Distractor 冷やされます (体が冷やされます) is acceptable Japanese close to the intended meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 冷やしました.

issues.jp_before: 両親[りょうしん]は三人[さんにん]の子[こ]どもを{育[そだ]てました|tr-okiru}。
issues.problem: Distractor 育てられました can be read as the potential/honorific form with を (were able to raise), which is grammatical and close in meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 育ちませんでした.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもが夜中[よなか]に{起[お]きて|tr-okiru}、泣[な]いていました。
issues.problem: Distractor 起こされて (was woken and was crying) is natural and fits the English 'woke up in the night'.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 起こさなくて.

issues.jp_before: この花[はな]は日当[ひあ]たりのいい所[ところ]でよく{育[そだ]ちます|tr-okiru}。
issues.problem: With は the distractor 育てます is grammatical as a topicalised object ('we often grow this flower in sunny places').
issues.action: Rewrote as この庭は日当たりがいいので、花がよく育ちます with が, so the transitive verb is ungrammatical; English and why updated.

issues.jp_before: スープを{温[あたた]めて|tr-okiru}いる間[あいだ]に、サラダを作[つく]ります。
issues.problem: English 'While the soup is heating' renders the intransitive meaning, not 温めている.
issues.action: English changed to 'While I heat the soup, I'll make a salad.'

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもたちには自然[しぜん]の中[なか]で元気[げんき]に{育[そだ]って|tr-okiru}ほしいです。
issues.problem: Distractor 育てられて (I want them to be raised healthy in nature) is natural and almost the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 育たないで.

issues.jp_before: このアプリを使[つか]う人[ひと]は毎年[まいとし]{増[ふ]えています|tr-okiru}。
issues.problem: With は the distractor 増やしています is grammatical as a topicalised object (we are increasing our users every year).
issues.action: Changed は to が; why updated to cite が.

issues.jp_before: 人口[じんこう]が{減[へ]って|tr-okiru}、学校[がっこう]が閉[し]まりました。
issues.problem: 学校が閉まる means the doors shut, not that the school closed down for good.
issues.action: Changed to 学校がなくなりました; English 'closed down'.

issues.jp_before: 手[て]が冷[つめ]たいので、ココアを飲[の]んで{温[あたた]まりたい|tr-okiru}です。
issues.problem: Distractor 温めたい is acceptable with the object (手) dropped from context, so the item had two answers.
issues.action: Rewrote as ココアを飲んだら、冷たかった手が温まってきました with が explicit; new distractors 温めて, 温めなくて, 温まらないで.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]、明日[あした]は五時[ごじ]に私[わたし]を{起[お]こして|tr-okiru}くれない？
issues.problem: 母 is a humble word for your own mother when talking to others. It cannot be used to address her directly.
issues.action: Changed the vocative to お母さん.

issues.jp_before: 単語[たんご]を{増[ふ]やす|tr-okiru}ために、毎日[まいにち]本[ほん]を読[よ]みます。
issues.problem: 単語を増やす alone is unnatural for 'build up my vocabulary'.
issues.action: Changed to 知っている単語を増やす.

issues.jp_before: 魚[さかな]は水[みず]のきれいな川[かわ]で{育[そだ]ちます|tr-okiru}。
issues.problem: With は the distractor 育てます is natural ('we raise fish in clean rivers').
issues.action: Rewrote as 水のきれいなこの川では、魚が元気に育ちます with が; English and why updated.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の近[ちか]くに新[あたら]しい店[みせ]が{増[ふ]えて|tr-okiru}、とても便利[べんり]になりました。
issues.problem: English 'New shops increased near the station' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'There are more new shops near the station now, so it has become very convenient.'

issues.jp_before: 夏[なつ]になると、客[きゃく]が{減[へ]ります|tr-okiru}。
issues.action: English changed to 'When summer comes, we get fewer customers.'
